name: Glass table filter
oneLiner: a database table on a glass pane: a cursor presses Filter, a filter chip grows out of the button, the rows that miss squash away, the matching few glide up and light, and the result count rolls over to the new number
say: when the speaker says they narrowed a big list down to the few that matter ('I filtered it to just the hot leads', 'only three of them were worth it'): the chip lands as they name the filter, the count rolls to the few
